The containerd v4 config egress-validation subject (opencharly/charly#929).
Installs containerd + crictl + crun + krun and ships the scratch fixture
project whose config: step carries the CONTAINERD.md section 3.1 version-4
config with validate: containerd_config. The bed
check-containerd-v4-egress-vm generates the fixture through the REAL
verb:egress validator, installs the exact bytes the validator accepted, and
asserts the running daemon serves the crun/krun runtime handlers and the
overlayfs snapshotter. A plugin-egress without the v4 arm fails the
generate with a version conflict, so the bed is red without the schema.

## Packages

Installed on every distro:

- `containerd`
- `crictl`
- `crun`
- `krun`

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | ship the scratch fixture project's project root into the guest home |
| `run` | ship the scratch fixture box that composes the egress-validation candy |
| `run` | ship the scratch fixture candy carrying the canonical v4 config and its egress validation |
| `check` | the scratch fixture project is shipped into the guest home with its egress-validation candy |
